scripts.build:modules: npm run copy:forum && npm run build --workspace=@modules/helloworld-frontend && npm run build --workspace=@modules/shop-frontend
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:shell && npm run build:modules
scripts.dev:modules: concurrently -n "SHOP-FE,FORUM-FE,HELLO-FE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace=@modules/shop-frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=@modules/forum-frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=@modules/helloworld-frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "DOCKER,SDK,SHELL" -c "magenta,cyan,yellow" "docker compose up" "npm run dev:sdk" "npm run dev:shell"
